Subject: SIG follow-up - outstanding artifacts for SOC2/pen test/ISO

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're starting the formal SIG review internally and have a short list of outstanding artifacts SomaHealth needs to close the security review:

- SOC 2 report (latest full report and bridge letter if available)
- Penetration test executive summary (redacted is fine)
- ISO statements / attestation (if you have an ISO27001 statement)
- Security overview slide deck for our risk committee

Can you confirm which of the above you can share and an estimated delivery date? Also let us know if there are any limitations (e.g., redaction, NDA/attestation required). We'd like to review before our compliance committee meets on Apr 20.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Anita Shah
Director, Information Security
SomaHealth

Hi Anita,

Thanks for the clear list — we can provide all four items. Proposed delivery plan below: 

- SOC 2: final report (Type II, 2027) + short bridge letter for 2028 coverage — targeted delivery Apr 15 (PDF)
- Pen test: redacted executive summary and remediation status — targeted Apr 16 (PDF)
- ISO: ISO27001 attestation statement (signed) — Apr 15 (TXT/PDF)
- Security deck: redwood security overview (slim, for committee) — Apr 18 (PDF)

Notes / asks:
- For SOC 2 and pen test we typically require a short evidence-sharing attestation (one-paragraph) to confirm you will not redistribute proprietary artifacts. If SomaHealth needs, we can attach an NDA addendum; let me know.
- Will the security deck need any customization for patient-data workflows? We can add a single slide if you want.

I'll loop in Rishi and Grace from our compliance team to execute redactions and upload artifacts to a secure Drive link.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales (Enterprise + Compliance)
Redwood Inference
